features: ✔ 360° Pan & Tilt Coverage – No Blind Spots Advanced PTZ function with 355° horizontal and 90° vertical rotation lets you control the view through your mobile phone and cover every corner effortlessly.
✔ 4MP Full HD Crystal Clear Video Enjoy ultra-sharp monitoring with a 3MP Full HD lens that delivers clear details day and night perfect for home, shop, office, and outdoor security.
✔ Two-Way Audio & Live View Anytime Built-in microphone and speaker allow you to listen and talk through the camera. Watch live feed and control the camera remotely from anywhere in the world.
✔ Color Night Vision with Dual LEDs Equipped with IR + White LEDs for full-color night vision up to 30 ft. Get bright, clear footage even in low-light or complete darkness.

✔ Smart Motion Detection & Instant Alerts AI-powered motion tracking instantly detects human movement and sends real-time alerts to your smartphone via the app ensuring you never miss an important moment.
✔ WiFi Connectivity + SD Card Support Stable 2.4GHz WiFi ensures strong connection. Supports up to 128GB SD card for continuous recording, plus optional cloud storage for backup.
✔ Weather Resistance & Design Outdoor-ready IP66 body ensures smooth performance in rain, heat, dust, and harsh weather ideal for home entrance, balcony, or shop exterior.
